The 'Neck strap' checkpoint was marked present despite the 'mushy' gathering noted in artifacts; this is acceptable as the function is visible, but the quality is low. artifact_review: The Router identified three key artifacts: texture anomaly (trim), structural collapse (hem), and perspective distortion (neck). I agree with these findings. The 'structural_collapse' at the bottom hem is the most significant defect, where the AI failed to render the physics of the split fabric, causing it to merge with the background. The 'texture_anomaly' on the trim is subtle but consistent with AI edge-bleeding. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions (noise/blur), which supports the idea that the defects are localized structural/textural issues rather than global generation failures. The Topology Auditor's high mask confidence (0.97) confirms the main body is coherent, isolating the defects to the boundaries and fine details.

The class conformance is strong, but functional completeness is slightly compromised.
